criterion_text: Normal completion, panic/assert, failed partial startup, timeout, SIGTERM and SIGKILL of a disposable run leave no live owned resources after bounded teardown/reaper; reaper proves run ownership, never kills live/foreign or deletes unverified dirs, and preserves auditable failure evidence. Legacy mixed-socket diagnostics dry-run and require explicit scoped authorization, never name-prefix-only deletion.
